### The Gain of Serving God
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-gain-of-serving-god
Passage: 2 Chronicles 12:8
Points:
- Serving God is fundamentally different from serving worldly masters or foreign powers.
- Because God has no needs of His own, serving Him is about receiving His grace rather than meeting His deficits.
- Judah was subjected to Pharaoh Shishak's rule as discipline to learn the stark contrast between both kinds of servitude.
- Earthly rulers take and exhaust their subjects, whereas God blesses and supplies all that His people need.
- Genuine obedience and worship are not burdensome obligations, but the joyful reception of God's continual gifts.
